messages:
lauren_product: Quick thread to pin down pilot acceptance and scope for the enterprise audit/evidence work. High-level asks from customers: exportable evidence bundles, tenant isolation, BYOK handshake, SOC2 mapping, and retention controls + legal hold. How do we scope a minimal pilot?

 tom_pm: Proposed pilot scope: immutable per-tenant log store, export bundle (tar.gz) with manifest + per-file sha256, BYOK opt-in (wrap-on-write), and basic retention tiers (30d/1yr/icu). No escrow for pilot.

 anika_legal: Legal asks: manifest must include signer identity, key id, timestamps, and a human-readable chain-of-custody summary. Need a legal-hold override flow and audit trail for holds/releases. Also confirm export integrity verification steps.

 mike_sre: Ops constraints: export jobs should be async. SLA for small range (<=30 days) is 2 hours; for large range (>30d) mark as bulk with 24h target. System must surface per-tenant backlog and retryability. Retention enforcement must be resilient to region failovers.

 jordan_eng: Implementation notes: stream events into tenant-specific append-only Kafka topics, compact to immutable objects in blobstore with versioned keys, manifest builder reads object index and emits signed manifest. BYOK: accept customer KMS public key to wrap payload key; store key metadata only.

 lauren_product: Packaging format idea: tar.gz with a top-level manifest.jsonl (newline-delimited JSON) where every line: {file_name, sha256, size, event_types, first_ts, last_ts}. Include a detached signature file.

 tom_pm: Pilot acceptance checklist suggestion: 1) 3 pilot tenants onboarded, 2) at least one export per tenant with manifest verification, 3) export success rate >= 97% for 7d, 4) runbook validated for legal-hold and restore, 5) BYOK handshake test with key rotation.

 anika_legal: Add: customer sign-off template that maps exported artifacts to SOC2 control IDs. Need a short data classification section in the template (PII/PHI flags).

 mike_sre: Alerting: jobs >30m -> warning, >2h -> pager. Track job queue length and per-tenant fail counts. Add export throttling: max concurrent exports per org = 3 (pilot) to avoid noisy neighbors.

 jordan_eng: Sample manifest line for reference: {"path":"2026/03/22/tenant123/log-part-0001.ndjson","sha256":"...","from":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2026-03-22T23:59:59Z"}. We'll include a small signature: manifest.sig (ed25519).

 lauren_product: Prioritization: Must-have for pilot = per-tenant isolation, export bundles with verifiable hashes+signature, retention enforcement, BYOK wrap-on-write, runbook. Nice-to-have = HSM escrow, streaming export API, per-event cryptographic receipts.

 tom_pm: Risks/costs: long retention tiers (multi-year) increase storage and restore cost. Recommend pricing or committed storage for >2yr retention. BYOK onboarding will add ~2-4 business days to ramp for some customers.

 anika_legal: Escrow note: we shouldn't enable automatic escrow unless customer signs additional contract. Keep escrow out of pilot.

 jordan_eng: Ops infra note: provisioned a pilot namespace and a low-cost cold tier for archival (digest-only retrieval faster than full restore). We'll implement delta exports with watermark tokens to support incremental exports.

 mike_sre: Monitoring: export duration histogram, export size, manifest verification failures, per-tenant backlog. Also add an audit SLI: percent of manifests that validate against stored objects over sampled window.

 lauren_product: Roadmap slots (Q): Q1 pilot infra + 3 customers + runbook. Q2 GA: billing lanes for retention, SOC2 mapping automation, faster restore UX. Q3: optional escrow/HSM, streaming exports, more granular access controls.

 tom_pm: Action items: @jordan_eng write the pilot design doc with API examples and sample manifests; @mike_sre create runbook + alerting; @anika_legal draft customer acceptance + privacy checklist for exported PII redaction options; I'll coordinate customer invites.

 ops_bot: infra-bot: Created: pilot-audit-namespace-02. Topics: tenant-123, tenant-234, tenant-789. Blobstore: s3://pilot-audit-2026.

 jordan_eng: I'll include curl examples in the doc, e.g.: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/x-ndjson" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{t}/audit/export?from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-22`

 anika_legal: One last ask: include a minimal redaction preset (email, ssn) for customers who require PII removed before export. Make redaction a toggle in the pilot.

 lauren_product: Good. We keep redaction gated but available. Thanks all — I'll book a 30m pilot kickoff with the pilot customers and owners. Moving to Pilot lane. :rocket:
